summary: SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: continue repairs, tests and protected merges. Complete PLF-089 / GitHub194 with explicit completion enqueue policy, durable idempotent asynchronous delivery and restart recovery.

delivery.outcome: Opted-in SDK/store/API completion queues exact GitHub tickets locally; authorized retry workers recover missed enqueue after restart and deliver using existing fenced retry, mapping and success receipts. Independently verified protected merge and installed runtime readback.
nonGoals: No fleet or worker service deployment
No incremental synchronization work owned by PLF-091
No new dependencies, remote protocol or repository allocation

architecture.decision: Reuse GitHub RetryQueue for revision-fenced local completion jobs. A literal boolean opt-in integration setting enables enqueue after successful store mutation under its existing lock; config inspection uses the credential-redacting, non-dotenv configuration reader. A bounded authorized retry worker reconciles done tickets in this project before delivery to recover commit/enqueue crash gaps. Queue errors warn that local completion is committed; worker reconciliation errors fail visibly without reporting remote success. Existing delivery receipts, repository guards and Retry-After survive.
interfaceChanges: drain_retries completion reconciliation when policy is enabled
architecture.rollback: Revert protected merge; retain ignored retry jobs and use existing explicitly invoked worker.

validation.evidence: Meaningful regression before source; default/no-route no enqueue, SDK/API/sharded done enqueue, failure/restart reconciliation, CAS rejection, concurrent revision fencing/cooldown/dry-run, native and real scoped canary, exact-head/base OneDev and independent merge.
